---

* NEW. Added environment variable HTS_GCS_HOST, analogous to the existing HTS_S3_HOST, to redirect gs:// URLs to a caller-specified endpoint.
  (PR #2051.  Thanks to Peter Dowdy)

Updates
-------

* Various code quality improvements.  Added memory and error checks.  Some changes to better data types.
  (PR #2054, PR #2059, PR #2064, PR #2066, PR #2070, PR #2073, PR #2075, PR #2077, PR #2078)

* Add a new format option to strip UR tags from CRAM.
  (PR #2056, partial fix for samtools/samtools#2327.  Requested by Florian Plaza Oñate)

* Report when khash can no longer expand.
  (PR #2063)

* Use multi iterators in the synced reader.  This adds bcf_itr_regions() and tbx_itr_regions() interfaces as BCF and tabix equivalents to sam_itr_regions().  This can speed up `bcftools view`.
  (PR #2052, fixes samtools/bcftools#2557. Reported by Carsten Erickson)

* Apply CURL_CA_BUNDLE environment variable in the S3 backend.
  (PR #2069.  Thanks to John Marshall)

* Cram embed_ref=2 and huffman optimisation.
  (PR #2082)

* API fix. Protect against out of bounds ref id in cram_put_bam_seq.
  (PR #2087)

* Adds validation to options specified using hts_opt_add or cram_set_voption. Mostly for overflow detection.
  (PR #2095. Reported by Sn0wyDay)

* Return an error instead of calling abort in hts_getline().
  (PR #2093, fixes #2091.  Reported by an)

* bcf_set_variant_type() now recognises single break-ends as described in section 5.4.9 of the VCF 4.5 specification.
  (PR #2115, fixes #2108)

Build Changes
-------------

* Add more CI tests for a variety of Linux and non-Linux platforms.
  (PR #2053)

* Update build badge, remove .cirrus.yml, spelling corrections.
  (PR #2071.  Thanks to John Marshall)

* Make check_copyright.pl better at skipping auto-generated files.
  (PR #2080)

* Use bash and pipefail for tests using simple_test_driver.sh
  (PR #2083)

* Add S3 integration tests.
  (PR #2067.  Thanks to Peter Dowdy)

Bug fixes
---------

* Fix a use-after-free bug when renewing http authentication tokens. This could happen if the file used to supply a replacement token was not present at renewal time.
  (PR #2119 Reported by Xuqing Yang. https://github.com/samtools/htslib/security/advisories/GHSA-x79c-vxf6-6j9c)

* Fix use-after-free and double free when handling file close errors in the preload:// file reader.
  (PR #2119 Reported by Xuqing Yang. https://github.com/samtools/htslib/security/advisories/GHSA-5cvj-m89h-h3cw)

* Fix inconsistent region list clean-up on hts_itr_regions() failure. This function takes ownership of the region list passed to it, even if it fails due to out-of-memory conditions.  Not accounting for this correctly led to a possible double free in the functions used to build multi-region iterators.
  (PR #2119. Reported by Xuqing Yang. https://github.com/samtools/htslib/security/advisories/GHSA-2r8w-wxh5-c7r8)

* Fix a double free on out-of-memory conditions in the CRAM BYTE_ARRAY_LEN encoder.
  (PR #2119. Reported by Xuqing Yang. https://github.com/samtools/htslib/security/advisories/GHSA-2r8w-wxh5-c7r8)

* Fix possible free of an uninitialised pointer if read errors occurred when loading .bai, .csi, or .tbx indexes.
  (PR #2119. Reported by maxmlz. https://github.com/samtools/htslib/security/advisories/GHSA-38qp-vpxq-r6xc)

* Properly validate index metadata before attempting to access it.
  (PR #2119. https://github.com/samtools/htslib/security/advisories/GHSA-vhg8-qwm7-cv9m)

* Fix use-after-free in bcf_sr_destroy1() if it tries to report an error on file close.
  (PR #2119. Reported by Junki Lee. https://github.com/samtools/htslib/security/advisories/GHSA-644m-mq4p-c7c6)

* Reject VCF records containing ASCII NUL bytes in FORMAT data.
  (PR #2119. Reported by haehet. https://github.com/samtools/htslib/security/advisories/GHSA-6qq4-hj39-g6ph)

* Validate tid value passed to hts_idx_get_stat() to prevent out-of-bounds reads.
  (PR #2119. Reported by haehet. https://github.com/samtools/htslib/security/advisories/GHSA-vhg8-qwm7-cv9m)

* Fix an undefined behaviour in os/rand.c
  (PR #2050)

* Fix heapsort bug and add ksort tests and improved documentation in comments.
  (PR #2055)

* Fix possible leak of bgzidx_t::offs and changes to bgzidx_t::noffs and bgzidx_t::moffs data types.
  (PR #2057)

* Remove an assert in cram_index_build and have it fail more gracefully.
  (PR #2061, fixes #2060.  Reported and co-authored by Shujie Xiang)

* Remove an infinite loop in bam_mods_at_qpos().
  (PR #2068)

* Avoid calling libcurl functions if curl_global_init() failed.
  (Part of PR #2069.  Thanks to John Marshall)

* Make sam_format_aux1 'A' type be nul terminated.
  (PR #2079)

* Fix multiple VCF header parsing bugs.
  (PR #2074, fixes #2065  Reported by Mark Woon)

* Prevent integer overflow in resolve_cigar2().
  (PR #2072)

* Improved code testing with the addition of a fuzzer for the expression filters (hts_expr).  This resulted in the detection and correction of several serious expression parsing bugs.
  (PR #2076)

* Fix leak of region list in hts_itr_multi_bam().
  (PR #2084)

* Improve checking of SEQ/CIGAR consistency when processing records with CG tags.
  (PR # 2089. Fixes oss-fuzz issue  560967311)

* Stop the CRAM zlib decoder from getting stuck in an endless loop.
  (PR #2085, fixes #2081.  Reported by Sewon Ahn)

* Fix hts_set_filter_expression(fp, NULL) so that it properly disables filtering without leaving a dangling pointer.
  (PR #2094.  Reported and code fix suggestion by Sewon Ahn)

* Tighten version number limits in bcf_get_version()
  (PR #2092, fixes #2088. Reported by an)

* Fix CRAM query of unaligned ('*') reads.
  (PR #2100, fixes samtools/samtools#2396.  Reported by Matt Sexton)

* Fix hfile_s3 reads failing at EOF on a part boundary.
  (PR #2098, fixes #2097.  Thanks to Peter Dowdy)

* Reduce CRAM decode memory usage when multi-threading.  Previous improvements to threaded throughput added greater memory usage, especially with long reads. This change mitigates that.
  (PR #2102, fixes samtools/samtools#2393.  Reported by Matthieu Muffato)

* Prevent negative range start in multi-region iterators, which could in some cases cause the index look-up to become stuck in an endless loop.
  (PR #2110.  Reported by haehet)

* Fix SQ line removal using sam_hdr_remove_lines().  It failed to update some internal sam_hdr_t structures, leading to deleted SQ lines reappearing, notably when writing BAM files.
  (PR #2105)

* Fix the wildly incorrect length value returned by hfile_mem_get_buffer() and hfile_mem_steal_buffer().
  (PR #2109)

* Fix a number of bugs that could be triggered by removing all samples with bcf_hdr_set_samples().
  (PR #2114)

* Fix fai_load3() crash if a .fai index was present but it attempted a rebuild because it also needed a .gzi one, and the rebuild failed.
  (PR #2116)

* HTSlib 1.22 changed the VCF reader so that it stored GT prefixed phasing information, but only for files specifying `fileformat=VCFv4.4` or higher. This caused problems when merging files with different versions, so the VCF reader will now store prefixed phasing information irrespective of the VCF version listed in the file headers.  For files up to VCFv4.3, the first phasing bit will be set if all other alleles are phased, and cleared otherwise (following the rules for VCFv4.4 onwards where no explicit phasing symbol is present). Note this release changes the default output CRAM version from 3.0 to 3.1.  HTSlib and SAMtools have been able to read CRAM 3.1 since version 1.12, however other tools may not yet be able to cope.  We know Noodles reads CRAM3.1 and htsjdk has a draft implementation that has not yet been released.
HTSlib has options for modifying the output formats, which are exposed in SAMtools.  When specifying an output format you can explicitly change the version via e.g. `samtools view -O cram,version=3.0 ...`.
Further documentation on this change can be found at https://www.htslib.org/benchmarks/CRAM.html

HTSlib no longer fetches CRAM reference data from EBI's server by default. Your organisation may wish to set up local infrastructure to supply reference sequences, e.g., using the new ref-cache tool included in this HTSlib release.  See the `REF_CACHE` and `REF_PATH` environment variables documented in https://www.htslib.org/doc/reference_seqs.html and the SAMtools manpage for details.

The primary user-visible changes in this release are updates to the annot-tsv tool and some speed improvements.  Full details of other changes and bugs fixed are below.

Notice: this is the last SAMtools / HTSlib release where CRAM 3.0 will be the default CRAM version.  From the next we will change to CRAM 3.1 unless the version is explicitly specified, for example using `samtools view -O cram,version=3.0`.

Updates
-------

* Extend annot-tsv with several new command line options.
    `--delim` permits use of other delimiters.
    `--headers` for selection of other header formats.
    `--no-header-idx` to suppress column index numbers in header.
  Also removed `-h` as it is now short for `--headers`.  Note `--help` still works. (PR #1779)

* Allow `annot-tsv -a` to rename annotations. (PR #1709)

* Extend `annot-tsv --overlap` to be able to specify the overlap fraction separately for source and target. (PR #1811)

* Added new APIs to facilitate low-level CRAM container manipulations, used by   the new `samtools cat` region filtering code. Functions are:
  ```
  cram_container_get_coords()
  cram_filter_container()
  cram_index_extents()
  cram_container_num2offset()
  cram_container_offset2num()
  cram_num_containers()
  cram_num_containers_between()
  ```
  Also improved `cram_index_query()` to cope with `HTS_IDX_NOCOOR` regions.  (PR #1771)

* Bgzip now retains file modification and access times when compressing and decompressing. (PR #1727, fixes #1718.  Requested by Gert Hulselmans.)

* Use `FNV1a` for string hashing in `khash`.  The old algorithm was particularly weak with base-64 style strings and lead to a large number of collisions.  (PR #1806.  Fixes   samtools/samtools#2066, reported by Hans-Joachim Ruscheweyh)

* Improve the speed of the `nibble2base()` function on Intel (PR #1667, PR #1764, PR #1786, PR #1802, thanks to Ruben Vorderman) and ARM (PR #1795, thanks to John Marshall).

* `bgzf_getline()` will now warn if it encounters UTF-16 data. (PR #1487, thanks to John Marshall)

* Speed up `bgzf_read()`.  While this does not reduce CPU significantly, it does increase the maximum parallelism available permitting 10-15% faster decoding. (PR #1772, PR #1800, Issue #1798)

* Speed up `faidx` by use of better `isgraph()` methods (PR #1797) and whole-line reading (PR #1799, thanks to John Marshall).

* Speed up `kputll()` function, speeding up BAM -> SAM conversion by about 5% and also samtools depth.  (PR #1805)

* Added more example code, covering fasta/fastq indexing, tabix indexing and use of the thread pool. (PR #1666)
